items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And Speedy was on the drums.

ctx.x: Wooo, yeah. He had this lead trumpet player, who was also a fine educator too. And he was just a wonderful —
And Speedy was on the drums.
And Speedy Jones was playing the drums, and Jackie Byard was playing piano.
